unitTitle: The Imperative - Reflexive Pronouns - Might/Could - Must/Have to - Can/Be allowed to - Could/Couldn't

pairsWith.noteUz: might/could, have to / don't have to, must / mustn't mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 10-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (52-bet, PDF 51). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '10'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Might/Could':
4) 'Match column A to column B, then ask and answer questions, as in the example.' 'When you travel abroad' (chamadon rasmi). A: 1 Tell someone where you are travelling to. 2 Have some of the local currency with you. 3 Reserve a hotel room before you leave. 4 Don't take any valuables with you. 5 Always carry your passport with you. B: a You could have trouble finding a place to stay. b Someone might steal them or you might lose them. c You might have to prove your identity. d They might need to contact you. e You might not find banks open when you arrive. SA: Tell someone where you are travelling to. SB: Why? SA: They might need to contact you.
'Must - Have to':
5) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct form of have to or don't have to.' 1 You ...... do the shopping. I went to the supermarket this morning. 2 John ...... do his homework first. Then he can watch TV. 3 I ...... clean my room every Saturday. 4 Susan is ill today. She ...... go to school. 5 They ...... work on Sundays. The shop is closed. 6 I ...... take the dog for a walk every morning. 7 James goes to a private school. He ...... wear a school uniform. 8 Brian ...... come with us. He can stay at home. 9 We ...... be at the theatre at 8 o'clock. 10 Sally ...... catch the bus to work. She has a car.

O'NG USTUN:
6) 'Look at the rules and guidelines for waiters in the table below. Tick the correct column, then make sentences, as in the example.' SURAT: ofitsiant. JADVAL (Waiters ... / must / mustn't / don't have to): be polite to customers - must ✓; know all the dishes on the menu; be slow with the customer's order; be very tall; forget what the customer ordered; make sure the customer is satisfied; be good cooks. Waiters must be polite to customers.
7) 'Look at the prompts and make sentences using must, mustn't or don't have to, as in the examples.' 1 you/be/quiet/in the library → You must be quiet in the library. 2 you/do/the ironing - I/do/it/yesterday → You don't have to do the ironing. I did it yesterday. 3 you/smoke/in a hospital - it/not be/allowed 4 Sara/study/hard - she/have/a test/tomorrow 5 we/go/to bed early - it/be/Sunday tomorrow 6 you/talk/to strangers - it/not be/safe 7 you/eat/fatty foods - it/be/unhealthy

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '52'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match column A to column B, then ask and answer questions, as in the example. When you travel abroad: A: 1 Tell someone where you are travelling to. 2 Have some of the local currency with you. 3 Reserve a hotel room before you leave. 4 Don't take any valuables with you. 5 Always carry your passport with you. B: a You could have trouble finding a place to stay. b Someone might steal them or you might lose them. c You might have to prove your identity. d They might need to contact you. e You might not find banks open when you arrive. Example: SA: Tell someone where you are travelling to. SB: Why? SA: They might need to contact you.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunni B ustunga moslang, so'ng savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. Chet elga sayohat qilganda: A: 1 Kimgadir qayerga ketayotganingizni ayting. 2 Mahalliy valyutadan bir oz oling. 3 Ketishdan oldin mehmonxona xonasini band qiling. 4 Qimmatbaho narsalarni olmang. 5 Pasportingizni doim o'zingiz bilan olib yuring. B: a Turar joy topishda qiynalishingiz mumkin. b Kimdir o'g'irlashi yoki yo'qotishingiz mumkin. c Shaxsingizni tasdiqlashingizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin. d Ular siz bilan bog'lanishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin. e Kelganingizda banklar ochiq bo'lmasligi mumkin. Namuna: A: Kimgadir qayerga ketayotganingizni ayting. B: Nega? A: Ular siz bilan bog'lanishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT + SABAB (might/could).

  1 Tell someone → d They might
    need to contact you.
  2 local currency → e You might
    not find banks open.
  3 Reserve a hotel → a You could
    have trouble finding a place
    to stay.
  4 Don't take valuables → b
    Someone might steal them.
  5 Carry your passport → c You
    might have to prove your
    identity.

  Dialog: A: MASLAHAT. B: Why? A:
  SABAB (might/could).


⚠ 'LOCAL CURRENCY':

  = mahalliy valyuta.


⚠ 'VALUABLES':

  = qimmatbaho narsalar.


⚠ 'TO PROVE YOUR IDENTITY':

  = shaxsini tasdiqlamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the rules and guidelines for waiters in the table below. Tick the correct column (must / mustn't / don't have to), then make sentences, as in the example. Waiters: be polite to customers; know all the dishes on the menu; be slow with the customer's order; be very tall; forget what the customer ordered; make sure the customer is satisfied; be good cooks.
exercises.instructionUz: Ofitsiantlar uchun qoidalarga qarang. To'g'ri ustunni (must / mustn't / don't have to) belgilang, so'ng gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Ofitsiantlar: mijozlarga muloyim bo'lish; menyudagi barcha taomlarni bilish; mijoz buyurtmasini sekin bajarish; juda baland bo'yli bo'lish; mijoz nima buyurganini unutish; mijoz mamnun ekaniga ishonch hosil qilish; yaxshi oshpaz bo'lish.
exercises.explanationUz:
OFITSIANT QOIDALARI.

  MUST (kerak): be polite; know
    the dishes; make sure the
    customer is satisfied
  MUSTN'T (taqiq): be slow; forget
    the order
  DON'T HAVE TO (shart emas): be
    very tall; be good cooks


⚠ 'A CUSTOMER':

  = mijoz.


⚠ 'SATISFIED':

  = mamnun, qoniqqan.
exercises.exampleEn: Waiters must be polite to customers.
modelAnswers: 1 Waiters must be polite to customers.
2 Waiters must know all the dishes on the menu.
3 Waiters mustn't be slow with the customer's order.
4 Waiters don't have to be very tall.
5 Waiters mustn't forget what the customer ordered.
6 Waiters must make sure the customer is satisfied.
7 Waiters don't have to be good cooks.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Ofitsiantlar mijozlarga muloyim bo'lishi kerak. (NAMUNA - must)
2 Ofitsiantlar menyudagi barcha taomlarni bilishi kerak. (must)
3 Ofitsiantlar mijoz buyurtmasini sekin bajarmasligi kerak. (mustn't)
4 Ofitsiantlar juda baland bo'yli bo'lishi shart emas. (don't have to)
5 Ofitsiantlar mijoz nima buyurganini unutmasligi kerak. (mustn't)
6 Ofitsiantlar mijoz mamnun ekaniga ishonch hosil qilishi kerak. (must)
7 Ofitsiantlar yaxshi oshpaz bo'lishi shart emas. (don't have to)

patterns.formula: A: MASLAHAT. B: Why? A: KIM + might / could + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: A: Always carry your passport with you. B: Why? A: You might have to prove your identity.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Pasportingizni doim olib yuring. B: Nega? A: Shaxsingizni tasdiqlashingizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: KIM + has / have to + FE'L (kerak) / KIM + doesn't / don't have to + FE'L (shart emas)
patterns.exampleEn: John has to do his homework first. Sally doesn't have to catch the bus. She has a car.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon avval uy vazifasini qilishi kerak. Salli avtobusga chiqishi shart emas. Mashinasi bor.

patterns.formula: Waiters must / mustn't / don't have to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Waiters must be polite. Waiters mustn't be slow. Waiters don't have to be tall.
patterns.exampleUz: Ofitsiantlar muloyim bo'lishi kerak. Sekin bo'lmasligi kerak. Baland bo'yli bo'lishi shart emas.
